pull.title: jobs: publish with wallet plus Stripe shortfall payment
pull.body:
## Summary

Adds a production-oriented publish-with-payment flow so a requester can fund a job with existing wallet balance plus only the missing Stripe amount.

### Example: 70 PLN job / 25 PLN wallet
- 25 PLN is reserved immediately from the wallet
- the pending publication stays private; no public Job exists yet
- Stripe Payment Element asks for only the 45 PLN shortfall
- a signed `payment_intent.succeeded` webhook uses the existing payment ledger
- server-side settlement releases the 25 PLN reservation, creates the real Job and locks the complete 70 PLN as HELD escrow
- only then can discovery / saved-search alerts observe the job

### Backend / ledger
- Flyway V40 adds private `job_publications`
- stable client request id + payload SHA-256 make publication preparation idempotent
- user/wallet/publication/route locking closes normal concurrent-spend and cancel/webhook races
- full-wallet publications keep the existing immediate publish + escrow path
- partial-wallet publications use `JOB_PUBLICATION_RESERVE` / `JOB_PUBLICATION_RELEASE`
- online shortfall has a 1 PLN minimum; any surplus remains in wallet
- single online publication payment capped at 10,000 PLN
- abandoned payment sessions expire and restore reservations idempotently

### Stripe
- dedicated PaymentIntent purpose `JOB_PUBLICATION`
- stable Stripe idempotency key per publication
- reuses Payment Element + automatic payment methods instead of separate card/BLIK backend flows
- webhook routing remains signature-gated
- duplicate webhook cannot publish a second job
- late payment after cancel/expiry is credited to wallet but never resurrects a publication
- if a valid payment arrives after the publication can no longer safely create its job, status becomes `PAYMENT_RECEIVED`; private payload is cleared and funds remain available in wallet

### Web
- Create Job now first prepares server-side funding
- if wallet covers the budget, it publishes immediately
- otherwise the form is frozen and shows total budget, wallet reservation, shortfall and actual Stripe charge
- shared Stripe.js loader is reused by wallet top-up and job publishing
- frontend never trusts Stripe success as proof of publication; it polls the private backend publication state and only finishes on `PUBLISHED`
- cancel releases the wallet reservation

### Privacy
- payment-pending data is not represented as a Job status
- no pending publication leaks into discovery, chat, proposals, reports, saved jobs, attachments or saved-search alerts
- serialized pending job payload is owner-only and cleared on terminal states
- Stripe metadata does not include job description or exact location

### Tests / operations
- unit regressions cover wallet reserve/idempotency/cancel/full-wallet path and webhook publish/duplicate/late/amount-mismatch behavior
- dedicated PostgreSQL + REST `Job publication payment smoke` verifies 70/25 reserve, replay idempotency, cancellation restore/private-payload cleanup, and fully-funded public Job + HELD escrow
- `docs/JOB_PUBLICATION_PAYMENTS.md` documents state, ledger sequence, TTL, late-payment behavior and privacy

Do not merge until every latest-head check is green.

issue.title: jobs: recover unfinished publication payments
issue.body:
## Summary
- add owner-only `GET /jobs/publications/pending` for active, unexpired `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` publication attempts
- keep recovery privacy-safe: responses contain only the existing payment/publication summary and never serialized job payload, exact address, route payload, Stripe secret, or another user's publication
- sort recoverable attempts newest-first
- make Create Job automatically resume the newest unfinished publication after reload or reopening the page
- reuse the existing Payment Element/payment-intent flow, cancellation semantics, webhook settlement and polling instead of creating a second payment path
- add focused service regression coverage for owner scoping and anonymous enumeration denial

## Why
PR #92 made publish-with-wallet-plus-Stripe safe and idempotent, but the browser only retained a pending publication ID in component state. Reloading, reopening the page, or moving to another device therefore stranded the UX until the reservation expired. This slice makes the existing server-side state discoverable by its owner and reconnects the frontend to it.

## Privacy / accounting
- only `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` rows owned by the authenticated user and not past `expiresAt` are discoverable
- no pending publication becomes a public Job
- no wallet movement occurs during recovery reads
- reservation release remains exclusively in existing cancel/expiry/settlement paths
- no schema or Flyway migration is required

Do not merge until every latest-head CI/check is green.
